# Flux Hands 1.0.8

- Android ARM64 app build for Android 15 and newer, using a remote OpenHands Agent Server.
- Free Kilo model catalog and OpenAI-compatible remote model settings on Android.
- Android APK is attached to this GitHub Release by the Android CI build.
- Desktop continues to support local GGUF models, llama.cpp, Hugging Face downloads, and remote agents.
